subject: Request: Cross-region P1/P2 Guardrail Adjustment + Standby Credit Proposal
messages:
From: Ops Team <ops@kindredpayments.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Cross-region P1/P2 Guardrail Adjustment + Standby Credit Proposal

Hi Logan,

Quick note from the operations side at Kindred Payments — over the last 48 hours we've observed a recurring latency spike affecting EU transactions during the 02:00-05:00 UTC window. We've attached a small capture (latency-capture-20280718.csv) showing token-level tail latency for the affected routes. The impact: P1 incidents have remained rare, but P2 response times have slipped into the 4–5 hour band overnight, which is outside the window in our contract and is causing customer-facing delays.

Given our go-live timeline next month, we need a temporary, agreed mitigation rather than a longer-term SLA renegotiation. Specifically we'd like to request: 
- A temporary extension of the P2 response window from 2 hours to 6 hours for the 02:00-06:00 UTC maintenance window for a 3-week period,
- Standby credits to cover additional support headcount during the waiver period (estimate attached),
- A clarified escalation path and an on-call augmentation schedule for nights, with named contacts.

Can Redwood confirm whether you can offer a short-term waiver + standby credit and nominate emergency escalation contacts? If helpful we can jump on a 30-min call — Sophie (cc'd) can do early mornings CET.

Thanks,
Sophie Laurent
Ops Lead, Kindred Payments
attachments: latency-capture-20280718.csv (csv, 48KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Ops Team <ops@kindredpayments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 12:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Cross-region P1/P2 Guardrail Adjustment + Standby Credit Proposal

Hi Sophie — thanks for the capture and the clear ask. We're able to support a short-term operational relief plan while we investigate the root cause. Proposed items here so we can be concrete: 

1) Waiver window: temporary P2 window extended to 6 hours for the 02:00-06:00 UTC window for 21 days starting 2028-07-22.

2) Standby credits: Redwood will provide a pool equivalent to 72 support-hours (applied as credits against next two invoices) to subsidize on-call augmentation for that period. I'll attach a short terms doc.

3) Escalation ladder during the waiver: 
   - First responder: Kindred on-call ops (yours) 
   - Redwood rapid triage: P1/P2 bridge activated -> Primary on-call (Ben Carter) -> Secondary (Karthik Iyer) -> Ops Lead (Logan Wright) -> Leadership escalation (Grace O'Connor)

4) Telemetry & short-term mitigations: we propose enabling an EU-prefilter cache for the affected routes and increased batching limits at night for the 21-day window; infra will run a performance job to capture kernel-level tails.

Ben / Karthik: can you ack the standby credit and escalation ladder? If agreed I'll draft the waiver and signature page and send over a DocuSign.

Logan
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed-standby-credit-terms.pdf (pdf, 12KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: Cross-region P1/P2 Guardrail Adjustment + Standby Credit Proposal

Logan — forwarding with internal notes. Short answers below: 

- Standby credit: I can approve up to 72 support-hours as a credit for Kindred (DEAL-6789) for a limited 21-day operational waiver. This is within our sales credit authority for pilot accounts.

- Escalation ladder: agree with proposed ladder; request we make the leadership escalation contact explicit — Grace, please confirm you'd be on the 3rd-level escalation for EU nights if Ben/Karthik can't resolve within the window.

- Risk & precedent: granting a timed waiver is fine, provided we attach a strict end date and require Kindred to accept telemetry hooks + a post-mortem. We should also track this as a one-off credit in the billing system (finance code: SB-CREDIT-DEMO).

One-liners: 
Grace: +1 to being named for leadership escalation but only if infra signs off on the mitigations.
Karthik: confirm standby staffing plan & estimated hours used so we can invoice/offset.

Ben
Director, Customer Success

Hi Sophie — quick confirmation following internal approvals.

Summary of the agreement (signed waiver attached):
- Effective period: 2028-07-22 to 2028-08-11 (21 calendar days).
- P2 response window: temporarily extended to 6 hours during 02:00–06:00 UTC only.
- Standby credit: Redwood will apply a 72 support-hour credit to Kindred Payments (applies across next two invoices). Billing reference: SB-CREDIT-DEMO / DEAL-6789.
- Escalation ladder during waiver: Primary on-call (Kindred) -> Ben Carter (Redwood rapid triage) -> Karthik Iyer (secondary) -> Logan Wright (ops lead) -> Grace O'Connor (leadership escalation).
- Required telemetry: enable prefix KV caching and share nightly tail logs (we will provide a telemetry upload endpoint).

Next steps: 
1) Sophie — if this matches what you expect, please sign the attached waiver (DocuSign link below) so we can finalize the credit.
2) Redwood infra will schedule the EU-night prefilter change for 2028-07-22 00:00 UTC and run the capture job; we'll share short daily status notes during the waiver.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/#!/documents/ABC123/sign
Signed waiver attached: signed-waiver-20280725.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

If any of the named points need tweaks, call my cell +1-415-555-0172 or reply here. We'll treat this as a controlled, timeboxed operational change — no SLA rewording beyond the waiver.

Thanks and looking forward to reducing the tail impact quickly.

— Logan Wright
